reasoning: This workflow monitors a Google Sheet for new lottery winners in a ticketing system called FairTix. When a new winner is added, it sends them a professionally formatted email notification about their ticket reservation success, then updates the sheet with a status code and timestamp. The 36.1% error rate suggests reliability issues, likely with email sending or sheet updates. The email template reveals this is an anti-scalping ticketing platform that uses a 'Fair Queue' lottery system to distribute tickets to verified humans rather than bots, with transparent pricing (no hidden fees) and a 24-hour purchase window.
name: FairTix Lottery Winner Notification
businessNarrative: This workflow automates winner notifications for FairTix's anti-bot ticketing lottery system. When customers win the right to purchase tickets through the Fair Queue lottery, they receive an immediate email notification with purchase instructions and a 24-hour deadline. This reveals FairTix positions itself as a consumer-friendly ticketing platform fighting against scalpers and hidden fees, using lottery mechanics to ensure fair access to high-demand events.
trigger: New row added to lottery winners spreadsheet
dataFlow: Customer data (name, email, event, ticket price) enters from Google Sheets lottery results. System sends branded winner notification email and updates the source sheet with delivery status (200) and timestamp for tracking.
